en: Lostelle's Daddy
Oh, a customer? I'm sorry, I can't think about games right now. It's my daughter, Lostelle.
She went off to pick berries this morning, the way she always does, and she still hasn't come home!
Biker
Yo! Is this the place with the little girl? I saw a kid heading for the forest over on Three Island.
Our gang's taking that island over, so she'd better keep out of our way. Heh heh!
Lostelle's Daddy
Three Island? Then she's gone to Berry Forest, past Bond Bridge. And with a gang of bikers about...
Please, I beg you! Would you go and look for her? The Seagallop can take you to Three Island.
Lostelle
Daddy, I'm home! A trainer saved me from a scary Hypno in the forest!
Lostelle's Daddy
Lostelle! Oh, thank goodness. And thank you, {player}. I don't know how I can ever repay you.
Lostelle's Daddy
Please, find Lostelle! She must be somewhere in Berry Forest on Three Island.
What's that you've got there? A Meteorite? From Celio on One Island? He promised me one for my collection!
And you brought my Lostelle home too. Please, take this as my thanks for both.
Tell Celio thank you from me. I'm sure Bill and he could use some good news over on One Island.
Thank you for bringing Lostelle home. If there's anything I can do for you, just say so.
The games are up and running again! Come and play whenever you like. Lostelle loves having company.
Lostelle
Thank you for saving me! I'll always remember it. Next time I go berry picking, I'll bring you some!
Man
This game corner's games are played by friends together, over a link. Nobody's linking up these days, though.
Still, the owner keeps the place spotless. He's a good father, and a good host.
